name: Build and Publish Language Packs

# ساخت بستهٔ .abl برای هر ۳۰ زبان از روی assets/local/*.json و انتشار همه‌شان
# روی ریلیز langpacks-latest. این ورک‌فلو به سورس فلاتر اپ وابسته نیست —
# فقط از JSONهای ترجمه‌شدهٔ همین ریپو می‌سازد، پس هیچ زبانی جا نمی‌ماند.

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'assets/local/**'
      - 'tool/l10n/**'
      - 'tests/validate_language_pack_contract.py'
      - '.github/workflows/build-and-publish-langpacks.yml'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Validate locale parity (pre-build)
        run: python tests/validate_language_pack_contract.py

      - name: Build all language packs
        env:
          DOWNLOAD_BASE: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/langpacks-latest
        run: python tool/l10n/build_release.py

      - name: Validate language pack contract (post-build)
        run: python tests/validate_language_pack_contract.py --require-complete

      - name: Publish release (langpacks-latest)
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag: langpacks-latest
          name: Language packs (latest)
          generate_release_notes: true
          overwrite_files: true
          files: |
            out/lang_*.abl
            out/manifest.json
